tips.stuck_coding: Stuck this long usually means the mental model is wrong, not the syntax. Re-read the error from the top, or explain the problem out loud (rubber duck) before changing more code.
tips.stuck_research: Long single-source reading without progress is a sign to switch source or format: try the official docs example, or a 10-minute hands-on instead of more reading.
tips.skimming: Frequent tab-hopping under 25s each means nothing is landing. Pick one resource, and write a 1-line note per section before moving on.
tips.context_switch: Too many app switches in a short window fragments focus. Close unrelated tabs/apps and commit to one task for the next 25 minutes.
tips.no_break: Long continuous stretch with no break. Take 5-10 minutes away from the screen; retention and problem-solving drop sharply past ~90 minutes.
tips.passive: Long idle-heavy stretch in a learning app (likely watching/reading passively). Switch to active recall: pause and try to reproduce what you just saw from memory.
